claims.speaker: Bethany Braund
claims.sentence: We recognized revenue of $5.0 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $4.3 million for the same quarter of 2025, an increase of 15%.

claims.speaker: Bethany Braund
claims.sentence: The GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders for the third quarter of 2026 was $1.7 million, or a $0.30 loss per share, compared to the net loss attributable to common stockholders of $5.2 million, or a $1.23 loss per share in the third quarter of 2025.
